Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block

Class BlockFallback

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.block.BlockFallback
public final class BlockFallback extends Object
A replacement for a block in a version. The target is a key: it needs no existence in any version, custom keys are made with Palette.blockState(org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap, dev.opencollab.paletter.Lookup). Made with of(BedrockBlockType) or of(BedrockBlockState), and forced(); a value with equals, hashCode and toString.
Since:
1.0.0
